scope: Runtime pool cleanup and CLI failed-stop lifecycle only; no new feature or execution permission

confirmed_defects.trigger: Room generation or membership revision changes and previous runtime shutdown is false or raises
confirmed_defects.before: Old runtime was popped before stop confirmation. False allowed new dispatch; exception lost the only pool reference and could make later cleanup look successful.
confirmed_defects.after: Retain old reference until True; close pool and reject new dispatch on unconfirmed cleanup, including attempts through old epoch or another room.

confirmed_defects.trigger: One room runtime raises while the pool shuts down
confirmed_defects.before: List comprehension aborted, so later room runtimes were never asked to stop.
confirmed_defects.after: Attempt every retained runtime; return False if any stop fails or raises. Keep references for explicit cleanup retry.

confirmed_defects.trigger: Room worker produces an accepted response, but final runtime shutdown is unconfirmed
confirmed_defects.before: CLI reported failed server state but returned normally, allowing a supervisor to interpret the process as successful.
confirmed_defects.after: CLI exits nonzero with fixed runtime_cleanup_unconfirmed reason, durably latches stop/unreachable, reports failed state and closes journal/lease. Accepted message and done journal row remain intact.

final_selected.method: Standard pytest with existing strict account/process/network guard, no JUnit or platform override. Fake runtime callbacks; CLI integration uses the in-memory API and real Worker.

notrun: Actual provider cleanup/cancellation and first response/reconnect
MCP process integration and its blocked cmd.exe path
PostgreSQL, POSIX, browser and complete regression suite in this increment
interpretation: Selected synthetic lifecycle regressions pass. False or exceptional local cleanup is not provider stop confirmation. Existing actual-call uncertainty, credential caps, approval denials and automatic native-resume identity gate remain unchanged.
